name: Gris
source:
[spoiler]"Thief turned nomad, she spends most of her days in the wilderness, far from other people."[/spoiler]

Gris is a thief. [spoiler]She is untrusting, putting her own needs above those of others, but the travelers extends a helping hand a couple times, which helps nudge Gris towards a different life path. [/spoiler]
